title: Who can message you
summary: Privacy setting for who can start a chat or invite the person to a group. The server enforces it: invites it does not allow are refused. Strangers allowed by everyone arrive as chat requests.

choose.effect: PUT /v1/me/messaging. On failure the choice goes back and bipe_error_network shows.

notes: Contacts are people in a shared joined chat and invite pairs (ADR 0034); they can always invite.
verified also admits verified accounts; none exist until the badge ships, and bipe_messaging_verified_body says so.
Bipe logic: BipeAPIClient.messagingSetting and setMessagingSetting, BipeWhoCanMessage (iOS); BipePrivacySettings.refreshMessaging and setMessaging, BipeMessagingPresenter (Android).
